blocks.text: Alkanes ke substitution reactions roshni ki energy ki maujoodgi mein bohat reactive free radicals banne se hote hain. Ek misal alkane ke hydrogen ki jagah halogen atom ka lena hai, halogenation: alkanes dhoop ya UV roshni mein chlorine aur bromine se react karte hain jis mein hydrogen atoms yake baad deegre halogens se badalte hain, halogenation ki had istemal shuda halogen ki miqdar par munhasir hai. Fluorine se reaction bohat shadeed hai aur carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid ka mixture deta hai; iodine seedha substitute nahi karti kyunke reaction bohat sust aur reversible hai. Reactivity ki tarteeb F2 > Cl2 > Br2 > I2 hai.

items: Initiation: pehla qadam, jis mein halogen-halogen bond UV roshni ki energy se toot-ta hai: Cl2 hv ke saath Cl. + Cl. deta hai.

Propagation: doosra qadam, jis mein bane hue radicals alkane molecule par hamla kar ke mazeed free radicals paida karte hain: CH4 + Cl. se CH3. + HCl, aur CH3. + Cl2 se CH3Cl + Cl. Is qadam ke dohrane se halogen-substituted products (chloroalkanes) ka mixture milta hai.

Termination: aakhri qadam, jis mein do free radicals mil kar product banate hain. Chlorine radical aur alkyl radical mil kar chloroalkane de sakte hain, do chlorine radicals Cl2 dobara bana sakte hain, ya do alkyl radicals mil kar dugne carbon atoms wala alkane de sakte hain; yeh aakhri tareeqa kam-yaab hai aur sirf halki miqdar deta hai, magar us ka hona free radical mechanism ka saboot hai.

blocks.alt: Cl-Cl: bond se har Cl ki taraf ek fish-hook teer, hv wala teer, nateeja Cl. + Cl.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Initiation mein roshni Cl-Cl bond ko barabar torti hai (har Cl ko ek electron). Propagation mein Cl. methane se H cheen kar HCl aur methyl radical banata hai, phir methyl radical Cl2 se Cl le kar CH3Cl aur naya Cl. banata hai: yun zanjeer chalti rehti hai. Termination mein do radicals mil jate hain aur zanjeer ruk jati hai.

Shuru mein mixture mein chlorine jitni zyada, bane chloroalkanes mein chlorine atoms ka tanasub utna zyada: chlorine radicals se mazeed substitution se chloromethane CH3Cl, dichloromethane CH2Cl2, trichloromethane CHCl3 (chloroform) aur tetrachloromethane CCl4 (carbon tetrachloride). Haloalkanes be-hoshi (anaesthetic) paida karte hain, un ki anaesthetic taqat halogen atoms ki tadaad ke saath barhti hai, aur lab mein solvents ke taur par un ka istemal zehreela hone ki wajah se sakhti se nigrani mein hai.

blocks.alt: CH3Cl (chloromethane) se CH2Cl2 (dichloromethane), phir CHCl3 (trichloromethane), phir CCl4 (tetrachloromethane); har teer par Cl. aur har qadam ke oopar surkh qausi teer 'Further substitution with Cl. radical'.

blocks.prompt: Ethane ki free radical chlorination ke products ka andaza lagayein, aur woh halaat batayein jin mein alkanes ki halogenation se halogenoalkanes ka mixture milta hai (Quick Check 11.3d, e).
blocks.explanation: UV roshni mein chlorine ke saath ethane pehle chloroethane deta hai, phir mazeed substitution se dichloroethanes (1,1- aur 1,2-), trichloroethanes aur yun hexachloroethane tak, saath HCl, aur do ethyl radicals ke milne se butane ki halki miqdar. Mixture tab banta hai jab reaction roshni mein chlorine ki zyadati ke saath chalaya jaye ya jari rehne diya jaye, kyunke har chloroalkane dobara substitute ho sakta hai.

items: UV roshni mein free radicals se halogenation; reactivity F2 (shadeed) Cl2 se zyada Br2 se zyada I2 se zyada (seedha substitution nahi).

Initiation (Cl2 se 2 Cl.), propagation (CH4 + Cl. se CH3. + HCl; CH3. + Cl2 se CH3Cl + Cl.), termination (radicals milte hain; halki ethane mechanism sabit karti hai); yake baad deegre products CH3Cl, CH2Cl2, CHCl3, CCl4.
